extracted.intended_audience: MIT researchers, inventors, students, entrepreneurs, and prospective licensees
extracted.subtask_description: An institutional index of guidance and resources about patents, trademarks, copyrights, licensing, and commercialization targeted to members of the MIT community and potential licensees. The page links to topic-specific guidance (e.g., licensee evaluation, AI use in patent activities, open source licensing, trademark use).

rubrics_metrics.name: What MIT Seeks in a Licensee
rubrics_metrics.description: Discover the key criteria MIT’s Technology Licensing Office uses to evaluate potential licensees, from commercialization readiness to mission alignment and technical expertise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key evaluation dimensions include commercialization readiness, mission alignment, and technical expertise; used by TLO to assess suitability of prospective licensees for MIT technologies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patenting & Commercializing Your Invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Once you have disclosed your invention, we'll work in close collaboration to move your invention through the patent and commercialization process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance covers steps and expectations for disclosing inventions, pursuing patent protection, and moving toward commercialization in collaboration with TLO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understanding the Licensing Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Get to know the key steps for licensing MIT technology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains procedural steps and milestones in MIT's licensing workflow (what to expect when engaging with TLO).

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidelines for Using Generative AI in Patent-Related Activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn about the implications of using Generative AI tools in patent applications and Invention Disclosures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses appropriate use, risks, and expectations when employing generative AI in drafting patent-related materials and disclosures; consult the guideline for specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: What It Means to Be a Named Creator on MIT-Owned Intellectual Property
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn what it means to be a named inventor, author, or contributor on MIT-owned IP. Explore the significance, benefits, and responsibilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes criteria and consequences for being listed as a named creator on MIT-owned IP, including rights, obligations, and recognition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understanding Expedited Licenses
rubrics_metrics.description: Accelerate your innovation journey with MIT's Expedited Licenses. Our guide helps you quickly access MIT software.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains eligibility and process for expedited licensing of MIT software to shorten time-to-use for certain technologies or projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exploring the MIT Open Source License: A Comprehensive Guide
rubrics_metrics.description: Dive into the history and significance of the MIT Open Source License. Learn how this permissive license empowers open source projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers terms, appropriate use cases, and implications of applying the MIT open source license to software and projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: MIT PatentScout™ Secure Patent Search Tool
rubrics_metrics.description: Access MIT PatentScout™: A secure patent search tool for MIT community. Discover, disclose, and innovate with confidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resource for prior art and patent landscape searching; recommended tool to inform disclosure and patenting decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name Wisely: Navigating Trademarks at MIT
rubrics_metrics.description: Discover essentials for choosing and using names and logos at MIT. Email us for guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides criteria and best practices for selecting and using names/marks consistent with MIT trademark policies and approval processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Students: Exempt Programs & Thesis
rubrics_metrics.description: While you own your thesis copyright, most of the intellectual property you produce at MIT is subject to ownership policies and agreements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies when student works (e.g., theses) are exempt versus when MIT ownership or other agreements apply; outlines student responsibilities and rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entrepreneurs & Startups
rubrics_metrics.description: Your guide to forming and cultivating a successful startup to market your university-based technology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on considerations, steps, and resources for founders seeking to form startups around MIT technologies (including licensing considerations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Approved Vendors for MIT Merchandising
rubrics_metrics.description: Are you an MIT DLC or student club wanting to use MIT’s name or logo? Start here! We collaborate with MIT Institute Office of Communications (IOC) to approve designs and connect you with approved vendors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes vendor approval criteria and workflow for official MIT merchandising and logo use; procedural requirements for clubs and DLCs.
